about: The expression language's cases written by hand (docs/specs/bayes-expression-language.md). A case without env is read by Parse alone: expect is {ok, ast, format} or {code, pos, len, args}; pos and len count code points. A case with env ({use, context}: one of envs, and the slot's context plate, "" for a single value) is read by Parse then Check: when accepted, expect adds type and interval (the catalogue's form, a missing bound infinite) and stan, the Stan text Emit writes with the Go tests' emission environment (an identifier is the node's name, a lifted index Up_<index id>_<plate>, the lags Lag<k>, the rows of an expression with lag Rows_lag; the mirror has no emitter and ignores it). An env lists its plates (kind rows, group with its parent, levels; series on the rows of a series) and its named nodes (role; type real, int, index with its target, time, not_number (a correlation matrix); plate, "" for a single value; declared interval). Read by the Go tests and by the TypeScript mirror.
